source.dps_metric: pinnacle_v1 honest DPS: exilegen Scorer dps_honest of the engine's pinnacle_v1 stats (fresh PoB config, Pinnacle boss, no conditional toggles, quest rewards kept) for the PoB-exported main skill; same as chain rows' 'pinnacle_v1.dps_honest'
source.note: Skill = the skill PoB measured (exported main socket group), not poe.ninja's stratum skill. share = poe.ninja main-skill count / all ladder characters (a character can count toward several skills; null when poe.ninja does not list the name; combo share only for poe.ninja's top 75 main skills). Everything else is over the sample: stratified by skill x ascendancy (about 6 builds per combination) and taken from the top of the experience ladder, so fractions and quantiles describe strong ladder builds, not ladder frequency. DPS quantiles skip builds with no DPS. Honest DPS from an engine re-evaluation of 1487 sampled builds (1 failed, 0 not evaluated: counted in n, left out of DPS). Chain rows' plain 'dps_honest' is the binding profile's (pinnacle_v1 or mapping_v1): compare with 'pinnacle_v1.dps_honest'.
